Subject: Kubota Garden, 55th Avenue South, Seattle, WA
Body:
Character: Jason Lemon #1 
Jason woke up early one day, grumpy and sour as usual because he wasn't a morning person. However it was a bright and warm day, perfect weather for a walk. He grabs his flask filled it up with warm green tea and started walking to his favorite spot, Kubota Gardens. As he thinks about the work he has to do, he couldn't help but make the connections between what he's been learning and the environment around him as he walks along the trail leading to the ponds. He observes the dragonflies flying across the water, the Japanese Stone Lanterns, and the water lilies floating in the pond; bending down he calmly looks at all the kois breaching the pond hoping for some food. "What a peaceful day" he thought before being interrupted by his stomach growling. 
Jay Nguyen
Location: Kubota Garden, 55th Avenue South, Seattle, WA
Author: Jay Nguyen (joeang12)
